The '''Thornhedge Pulsar''' was a [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]] at the center of the [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]]. The pulsar was the remnant of a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] that destroyed the [[Kyyr system]] and decimated the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route.<ref name="TEA" />
